title: Fix MCP timeline_update_layer: layer rename/lock not persisting in doc_get
description: Root cause: getDoc() in agent callbacks was a stale closure over React state doc. After pushDoc() triggers React setState(), the new doc is not committed to React state before the next MCP call arrives. Fixed in Shell.tsx by adding latestDocRef (useRef) that is updated synchronously in pushDoc() and read by getDoc() in setAgentCallbacks. All 22 agent-mcp E2E tests pass including the previously failing timeline domain round-trip.
